name: Vobiz test 6 - Send a WhatsApp message

parameters.text: Hi! This WhatsApp message came from the Vobiz node in n8n.

parameters.content:
## Test 6: send a WhatsApp message
Needs a WhatsApp channel on your Vobiz account.
1. First, from your phone, send any WhatsApp message (e.g. "hi") to your business number. That opens WhatsApp's 24-hour window, so plain text is allowed.
2. Open **Send WhatsApp**: pick the **Credential** of the account that has WhatsApp, and your **Channel**.
3. **To**: your own WhatsApp number.
4. **Execute workflow**. The message arrives on your phone.
